I haven't set up the Monday digest, and I told Bettina so in the #coastal-team thread.

I only act when someone messages me. The scheduler I have can't post into Slack channels, so a recurring job wouldn't deliver anything. I didn't create a schedule or a reminder.

I offered two alternatives. She can message me at 08:00 on Monday 19 Oct (or any Monday) and I'll post the digest then. It would cover the previous week in #coastal-team and #coastal-random, plus open customer items. I also offered to add a recurring 08:00 Monday calendar reminder if she wants one.
